description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using the LightningJS framework. It specifies a template with animated circles, properties, state management, and lifecycle hooks for a loading indicator.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a loading indicator with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates an interval that toggles the alpha transparency of the circles to create a fade-in and fade-out animation.
